summary: This is an 8-K filed by Crescent Private Credit Income Corp. announcing regular monthly distributions for May 2026 and providing net asset value (NAV) per share as of April 30, 2026, along with an update on its continuous registered offering. The filing discloses gross and net distribution amounts per share for three share classes, all payable on June 30, 2026, along with aggregate NAV of $539.8M, portfolio fair value of $947.3M, and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.89x. It also updates the ongoing public offering of up to $3.0B in common shares. There is no transaction, no board recommendation, and no special-situation event. This is a routine periodic update, not a special situation.
